title: the guarded class-registration stubs, one row per member
heading: ## Per-member rows: the vtable each guarded class-registration stub installs, and its reflected type (OPUS, 2026-10-03)
lead:
The family `guarded class-registration stubs` (frontmatter: 99 members; {N} get a row here) shares a pattern, not a form (129 to 3757 bytes), stated here once and not repeated per row. Under the thread-safe static-init guard (`008092FC` / `0080929C`), each stub constructs one or more static Phyre metadata objects and registers members and teardowns. Members differ in far more than the anchored instruction. Each row anchors the body's first `lea rax, [V]` whose following `mov` stores V into a static object X that the body also loads with a `lea`, and states V and the class V's MSVC RTTI complete-object locator names, read from the certified image: the template argument T for a `PClassDescriptor*<T>`, otherwise the decorated class.
- In 25 rows, X is the static class descriptor the body constructs. In 15, it is built through `00632D80` and V is its `PClassDescriptorAbstract<T>` vtable, which a later store replaces with `PClassDescriptorConcrete<T>`. In 10, it is built through `00632C90` and V is its `PClassDescriptorWrapper<T>` vtable.
- In the other 18, the body constructs no class descriptor. X is a static data-member object in 15 rows (`PClassDataMember*<…>`), a `PTypeDefault<unsigned int>` in `006315B0`, and a `PNamedSemanticDescriptorForType<…>` in `00661A70` and `006D5810`. {CHECK} re-derives every row and compares it with the committed {ROWS}. Two controls are refused: a swapped value and a moved anchor. Members that do not derive are listed in [`excluded.tsv`](../../_index/candidates/opus-ee-guarded-registration-1003/excluded.tsv).
value_col: first vtable V stored into a lea-loaded static
name_col: class named by the RTTI locator before V (T for a class descriptor)
